title: ATX Data Audit, Airport Recovery & Staffing Woes
meeting_type: Audit and Finance Committee Regular Meeting
summary:
*   An audit revealed significant data reliability issues across city departments, affecting the public "Open Data Portal" with outdated or inaccurate information, prompting calls for a citywide strategy and centralized oversight.
*   The Austin Airport Hilton Hotel made a strong financial comeback post-pandemic, fully repaying a $1.35 million loan to the airport earlier than anticipated.
*   Airport Hilton staff now earn a $20/hour living wage, and ongoing union negotiations are expected to finalize soon, potentially setting a national labor model.
*   Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (ABIA) continues to face a critical 35% overall staff vacancy rate, with some departments, like facility services, seeing 40% shortages, impacting operations.
